Name: Kuttinkhan  Estate
Desc: 250gm 100% Specialty Arabica We scored this gem of an Arabica nano lot from the Kuttinkhan Estate, where coffee adventures meet wild wonders! In the midst of Chikmagalur's untamed wilderness, Rebello Family, a fearless band of coffee pioneers, embarked on an epic journey. The Estate when first established was in the midst of a heavily forested & hilly terrain creating countless hurdles for the people trying to start the Coffee Plantation. With unyielding determination and a sprinkle of magic, they transformed the impossible into a caffeinated wonderland. We’ve sealed this flavor-packed expedition right inside this bag for you. Hop in & join in on this wild ride! ROAST : Light-Medium TASTES NOTES: HIBISCUS TEA, BERRY CRUSH, FRUITY ESTATE: KUTTINKHAN ESTATE VARIETY: 795-Chandragiri Block: Gandadkhan -D PROCESS: Anaerobic Fermented Naturals ELEVATION: 4150 Ft. ARTWORK BY: Denver.Fernandes

Name: Gravity Wave
Desc: 250gm Immersion Blend When the atmosphere and ocean interact it creates the tides. That’s a gravity wave. When this blend and water interact they create flavours so powerful, we felt like it was its own kind of Gravity Wave. Built for the long steep time of immersion brewing, the fluid dynamics of this liquid are made for tasty experiments with the french press and cold brew. ROAST : MEDIUM DARK TASTES LIKE : Caramel, Nutmeg, Citrus

Name: ROARING ROBUSTA
Desc: 250gm 100% Robusta Roaring Robusta isn't here to play it safe; it's here to fuel your fun! Indulge in the wild energy of 100% Robusta beans, skillfully roasted to a deep, luscious darkness. With a flavor profile that fearlessly flaunts its intensity, Roaring Robusta unveils notes of rich Dark Chocolate , a dash of Oaky intrigue, and a Nutty surprise that'll have you coming back for more. The caffeine surge? Think of it as a brain boogie, keeps you dancing in high spirits from sunrise 'til sunset. ROAST: Dark+ TASTES LIKE: : Dark Chocolate,Oaky, Nutty

Name: Timemore Crystal Eye Dripper
Desc: Time More Dripper is designed with a concave principle, the lower area of the dripper, instead of slowing down the brew actually increases, making the water flow more smoothly and the extraction more uniform. 1 - Insulating level - the filter paper completely attached to the smooth top part of the dripper so water cannot get through. 2 - Brewing level - where the brewing action should take place. 3 - Powder level - the ground coffee will fill the bottom area which is less ribbed and more flume to encourage the water flow and thus reducing the chance of over extracting.

Name: AEROPRESS GO
Desc: We think the team at the Aerobie office was looking at their award-winning Aeropress and wondering, " Hmm. What if the AeroPress...had a mini-me? " Because that's pretty much exactly what the AeroPress GO is all about. With a couple of tweaks thrown in to make it more suited to home espresso-like brewing. If the AeroPress was light , compact and portable , the AeroPress GO is lighter , compact-er and portable-er . Yes, we just made up those words. Deal with it. Being small isn't its only superpower. The Go also comes with a super dope foldable stirrer and a cool little box that can hold up to 15-20 filters and snaps shut! The kit now also comes with a plastic mug and a rubber lid that you can brew your coffee into and then use it to house the entire kit into one neat storage unit . If AeroPress was looking to make something that was on point for travelling , camping or just be easier to be outdoors and drink cafe level coffee - they nailed it! AeroPress GO Dimensions: 3.7 x 3.7 x 5.3 inches AeroPress GO Contains: AeroPress Plunger Chamber Lid Funnel Scoop Foldable Stirrer 350 microfilters discs Filter Holder Mug Rubber Lid

Name: Genmai
Tasting_Notes: Blonde Chocolate, Japanese Toasted Rice, Raspberry Spoiler alert: This is probably our favourite
Desc: Blonde Chocolate, Japanese Toasted Rice, Raspberry Spoiler alert: This is probably our favourite. If any chocolate were the gateway drug to a life in pursuit of high-quality cacao, this would be it. An accessible mix of caramel , sea salt and cooked milk is given the Japanese gift of umami courtesy some Genmai toasted rice . As a final flourish, Chef Prateek freckles it with bits of raspberrie s to give it a nice fruity tartness.

Name: Chestnut
Tasting_Notes: Ghanaian Milk Chocolate, Candied Chestnuts, Toasted Black Tea Chocolate infused with chestnut black tea for 48 hours
Desc: Ghanaian Milk Chocolate, Candied Chestnuts, Toasted Black Tea Chocolate infused with chestnut black tea for 48 hours sounds pretty out there already but of course, Chef Prateek kicked it up a notch higher. To contrast the sweet milk chocolate base for this bar, he’s even added toasted tea flakes from the infusion. Finally, to round up the balance, he’s dotted it with caramelized organic chestnut chips and coarse sea salt because, you know, why be good when you can be perfect?

Name: Starlet
Tasting_Notes: Bold raspberry body for the red, yoghurt for the creaminess and rose petals for a burst of complementary flavour
Desc: Ruby, Raspberry Chocolate, Rosepetal Yeah, you clicked cause it was a beautiful deep red bar of chocolate right? It’s cool, we did too. Elegance commands attention without needing to demand it and this bar knows that well. Bold raspberry body for the red, yoghurt for the creaminess and rose petals for a burst of complementary flavour. In case you’re wondering, yes, it does taste as good as it looks.

Name: Noir
Desc: 70% Dark Dominican Cacao, Volcanic Salt A good way to identify high-quality chocolate , like the fantastic Dominican single-origin dark chocolate in this bar, is to see if it comes packed with flavours of its own. Some bars are great just by themselves and this is definitely one of them. Topped off with a light sprinkle of volcanic salt [did you expect any less by now?], this bar keeps it simple and lets the cocoa sing with notes of pineapple , pecans and earl grey .

Name: Smoke
Tasting_Notes: 70% Dark Madagascar Cacao, Cherry Wood, Candied Orange Peel Dark chocolate and orange is a celebrated combo that sits
Desc: 70% Dark Madagascar Cacao, Cherry Wood, Candied Orange Peel Dark chocolate and orange is a celebrated combo that sits comfortably in the hearts of chocolate fans everywhere. So when Chef Prateek decided to take a stab at it, he knew he had to elevate the game . 70% Madagascar single-origin gets smoked overnight in cherry wood before being paired with in-house candied organic Malta orange . The smoke hits first and disappears while the orange hangs around for the party in your tastebuds.

Name: Aeropress Coffee Maker
Desc: Simple , portable and easy to use , the AeroPress has quickly become one of the cult faves for coffee fans worldwide . With a deep immersion and a short steep time , it gives full-bodied cups of coffee that are low on bitterness and high on flavour . Strained by using pressure to push the brew through a microfilter paper discs , the Aeropress can easily brew light, delicious black coffee as well as thick concentrated homebrews that are closer to espresso territory. Since it's made from Phthalate and BPA free plastic , it's super resilient and ridiculously easy to clean too! Remember that last brewer that broke in the sink? Yeah, that's never happening again. Ever. If you're looking for a brewer you can take with you everywhere you go to satisfy your chase for mindblowing coffee whenever you want it - this is it . Assembled measurements: 9 1/2" h X 4" w X 4" d Each AeroPress Kit includes: AeroPress Plunger Chamber Lid Funnel Scoop Stirrer 350 microfilters discs Filter holder
